column1: # What the controller needs installed, one row per thing, read by both the Dockerfile and
# nodes/install-controller.sh (R90 step 2), so the image and a bare-metal install cannot drift.
# Columns: what, need, then the packages for each provisioner family (nodes/families/*.sh).
#   core    the controller does not run without it: a bare-metal install stops when it does not install
#   tools   what a shell on the controller carries: installed where the family has it, said where not
#   image   the container's alone: its init, its user switch, apt's own helpers, and libraries only
#   vendor  the image takes it from the vendor's repository in the layer after the first; a bare-metal
#           install from the family's (EPEL's, on a RHEL rebuild)
#   docker  the image takes it from Docker's repository with the vendor rows; a bare-metal install has
#           it from the family's docker_install, which the cells say as @docker
#   host    a bare-metal install's alone: the image's base system carries it already
# A cell is packages split by spaces; a|b takes the first the machine's repositories have; - is none.
